title: Record field (the 2-0 after one week)
finding: median game ON: each team plays its opponent and the league median every week. League setting league_average_match = 1; wins across all rosters = 48 after 4 week(s) (head-to-head only would give 24, with a median game 48).

title: DEF projection bias (Sleeper omits 3-and-outs and 4th-down stops)
finding: Week 4: across 32 defenses, actual minus projected averaged -0.51 (MAE 2.84). Points from the two unprojected categories averaged 1.72 per defense, which is the structural part of the bias. Among the 12 defenses actually started, bias was -0.1.
